files.name: CapacityShelf.java

tests.name: Mutation lifecycle
tests.description: With capacity 3 add ink, chalk, wax; remove chalk; add clay.
tests.expected: Snapshots progress to [ink, wax, clay] with size 3; adding a fourth distinct label returns false.

tests.name: Snapshot ownership
tests.description: Change element 0 in a snapshot and request a new snapshot.
tests.expected: The shelf still starts with ink.

tests.name: Boundary and invalid operations
tests.description: Try zero/negative capacity, duplicate labels, null/empty labels and removing missing/first/last labels.
tests.expected: No invariant violation; specified exceptions and booleans hold.

reasoning: The active prefix has exactly size elements. Shifting a removed suffix left preserves order; clearing the old last active cell restores a null tail.
A copy has a different array identity. Strings themselves are immutable, so sharing their references does not expose mutable label objects.
